semantic_partitions: Independent: no binding/readiness relation beyond shared occurrence policy.
Chain: each consumed value identifies its actual immediate authored source, not a stale predecessor.
Fork: separate consumers read snapshots of the same authored producer output.
Join: all incoming predecessors terminal, not merely one branch.
